==Ingredients==

=== Crust ===
* 1¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] chocolate wafer crumbs
* ¼ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted

=== Filling ===
* ½ cup butter
* 6 squares (6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / 180 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) semisweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* ⅔ cup white granulated sugar
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]]
* ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ⅔ cup all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]

=== Topping ===
* 1 can (21 ounces / 600 g) [[Cookbook:Cherry|cherry]] pie filling
* 2  squares (1 ounce / 30 g) each) semisweet chocolate, chopped
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[cookbook:Cream|heavy whipping cream]]

==Procedure==

=== Crust ===
# Preheat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|350°F]] (175°C).
# In a small bowl, combine wafer crumbs and sugar; stir in butter.
# Press onto the bottom and up the sides of a lightly greased 11-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (30 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|tart pan]] with removable bottom.
# Place pan on [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
# Cool on a [[Cookbook:Wire Rack|wire rack]].

=== Filling ===
# In a [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]]-safe bowl, melt butter and chocolate; stir until smooth.
# Cool for 10 minutes.
# In a large mixing bowl, [[Cookbook:Beat|Beat]] the eggs, sugar, vanilla, and salt until thickened, about 4 minutes.
# Blend in chocolate mixture.
# Add the flour and mix well.
# Pour into crust; spread evenly.
# Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
# Cool completely on a wire rack.

=== Topping ===
# Spread pie filling over the top.
# In a small microwave bowl, combine chocolate and cream.
# Microwave on high for 20 to 30 seconds or until chocolate is melted; stir until smooth.
# Cool for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
# Drizzle over tart.
# Chill until set.

== See also ==

* [[Cookbook:Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte|Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte]]
